title: Yorkshire Pudding
tagline: A lumpy flour, egg, and milk batter baked in buttered muffin tins. Made to go with the prime rib.

steps.text: Sift 1 cup sifted flour with ½ teaspoon salt into a bowl.
Break in 2 eggs and 1 cup milk. Mix ingredients together just enough to moisten them. There should be lumps in the batter.
Pour into well-buttered fluted muffin tins, filling ⅔ full, and put in a cold oven.
Turn on to 400° and bake 30 to 40 minutes.
